churn_resistance.rationale: A framework or API upgrade would touch very few files thanks to the single data module, view-model-producing loads and one-place env config; it loses a point because the data boundary is completely untyped and some species/move decoding leaks into route files.

findings.issue: The PokeAPI boundary is entirely untyped (no JSDoc, no TS); API shapes are implicit in destructuring at every load, so upstream shape changes fail silently at runtime
findings.suggestion: Add @typedef declarations (or migrate to TS) for species/pokemon/move records, or validate with a small schema library like valibot — already supported by defineEnvVars schemas

findings.issue: Search debounce timer is never cleared when the component unmounts; a keystroke just before navigation can fire goto on a stale page
findings.suggestion: Track the timer in an $effect and clear it in the cleanup, or reset it in onDestroy

findings.issue: onMount re-implements hash scrolling that the SvelteKit router already performs (scroll + focus on hash navigation); duplicate behaviour can drift from the framework
findings.suggestion: Drop the manual scrollIntoView and rely on the router, using disableScrollHandling only if a genuine edge case appears

findings.issue: {#each sorted as row (row)} keys rows by object identity, which breaks subtly if rows are ever reconstructed
findings.suggestion: Key by a composite of move name and level (e.g. `${row.moveName}-${row.level}`)

findings.issue: Server-side fetch has no timeout; a hung upstream stalls the page indefinitely and the in-flight promise stays cached
The stat-bar width formula (value/255 clamped to 100) is duplicated inline for stats and the Total row
findings.suggestion: Extract a small bar-width helper (or a StatBar snippet/component)

findings.issue: No .gitignore; build/ and .svelte-kit/ artifacts appear committed next to source
findings.suggestion: Add the standard SvelteKit .gitignore and remove generated artifacts from version control

summary: This is about as forward-looking as SvelteKit code gets right now: it uses SvelteKit 3's newest APIs (shallow routing via goto + page.shallow, defineEnvVars, Vite-plugin config, the new error() signature) exactly as documented, with zero runtime dependencies and all data access funnelled through one module. The platform is used first everywhere, from fetch/URLSearchParams to intrinsic auto-fill grids, so upgrades would ripple into very few files. The one real gap for the future is the complete absence of types at the API boundary, plus a couple of trivial hygiene nits.
